ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast ratio; visible surface is approximately 96% low-intensity (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white/light) pixels localized almost exclusively at the distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes; high-contrast light pixel clusters localized at coordinates representing the distal tips; sparse punctate white spots <5 pixels in diameter scattered on the medial surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth relative to the vertical lobe span of roughly 14%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude of peaks ranges from 4 to 18 pixels; higher density of variations observed on the distal third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer margins of both lobes, transitioning to an acute upward sweep at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of dense, irregular, high-contrast light pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; left cluster measures approximately 45x30 pixels, right cluster measures approximately 35x20 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (~20 pixels in length) visible on the mid-medial region of the left lobe, oriented diagonally relative to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized light-colored irregular pixel masses at both lobe tips; significant jagged indentation and morphological asymmetry on the left distal tip margin.
